closing: Do not let the opportunity to understand your Lord pass you.

captions.en: If the Qur'ān was sent down, the wisdom of why it was sent down is for you to contemplate on it.
And that's the wisdom behind why it was sent down.
If you're not pondering on the Qur'ān, then the wisdom of why it was sent down goes.
It just becomes mere letters that have no effect.
